work: Take over THE ZOOM Mac prototype and rebuild it as a Sequoia desktop: Chicago wallpaper, glass menu bar and Dock, Control Center, desktop widgets, Finder list/icon/gallery views, three-pane Notes, Activity/Terminal/Hermes/Safari/Settings, ultrawide tiling, and a regenerated 3D monitor plate. Data remains corpus.json plus labeled host telemetry.

craft.note: Sequoia materials, squircle Dock, Control Center, and desktop widgets follow apple-design plus frontend-design. The owner asked for a faithful Mac mini workspace, not an unbranded schematic.
Pointer capture still drags 1:1. Dock hover is a short ease-out scale gated to fine pointers. Keyboard Spotlight has no animation. Reduced motion kills ornamental transform.
SF-system stack, tabular numbers on the Chicago clock, 16px search inputs on mobile, tighter tracking on Finder and Notes display headings, measure capped in the welcome note.
Neutral Sequoia windows, #0071e3 selection, warm Notes paper, Chicago dusk wallpaper as the only chromatic field. Widgets use translucent dark glass over the photograph.
Widgets occupy the left column from 1280px. Finder stops short of Notes. 32:9 leaves the skyline visible. 375px collapses to one window, a folder drawer, and a reachable Dock.
Named traffic lights, focus-visible rings, Hold the clock in Control Center for the auto-updating time, reduced-motion and reduced-transparency paths, and the script-free record remain.
Weather, Wi-Fi, battery, live CPU graphs, and live agent sessions are stated as not exported. Terminal keeps the banner that the browser does not execute commands on Richie’s Mac.

looked.saw: 1440 desktop now includes a Sequoia Dock with Messages, Chrome, Spotify, Claude, ChatGPT, and the official Hermes Agent mascot. Desktop icons sit under the widgets and drag. Messages has a Richie public talk thread and a Rutvik Thakkar contact card with mailto. Hermes credits Nous Research and links hermes-agent.nousresearch.com. Spotify states that no public playlist URL is in the export.
looked.mobile: 375x812 welcome note is full-width and readable. Kept-claim receipt expands with category, confidence, recorded result and verification command. Dock remains reachable. No horizontal overflow in the Playwright check.
looked.bar: This is a convincing Sequoia software prototype of Richie’s public Mac, not a claim of live execution on the machine. Hardware fields are labeled as a preview-time host read. Native Apple icons remain preview-only with redistribution rights not established. The 3D room is unchanged except for the regenerated monitor plate.

verdicts.reason: Harness configuration is outside this desktop pass; window interaction and record navigation were implemented in the existing preview.
The owner supplied a specific Mac direction. Apple design guidance was applied instead of choosing a broader visual style from this pack.
The implementation uses the existing public record and spatial navigation; a cloned website template would replace that useful foundation.
Headlines are static and readable at entry. Letter choreography would delay arrival at the workspace without explaining anything.
No asset from this broad package was imported; the available frontend-design skill informed composition directly outside the arsenal copy.
Native buttons, details, search inputs and selects cover the current controls. A component abstraction is not needed to make these controls functional.
No harness product or tooling surface was changed. The task is the visitor-facing desktop and its entry journey.
Animated borders would turn quiet Mac windows into attention effects. Window focus is already communicated by shadow and traffic-light state.
This pass applied the available Apple design skill to window mechanics. No separate package from this collection was incorporated.
The desktop must allow selection, links, native scrolling and keyboard focus. Its content is DOM, with only a distant screenshot on the 3D monitor.
The owner specifically redirected work away from the physical room. The existing camera route was retained while a direct desktop entry was added.
Opening the workspace requires no decorative loading cycle; the actual record fetch has a plain failure path and a direct record link.
An ASCII transition would reproduce the coded visual treatment the owner rejected. The photographic wallpaper remains continuous into the desktop.
The saved health and runtime data have no time series. Adding charts would imply observations absent from the export.
No Figma document is being delivered. Actual browser windows and screenshots are the reviewable source of this iteration.
The current request specifies the OS direction; Apple interaction guidance and rendered frontend review were used for this bounded replacement.
There is no video deliverable or timeline in the Mac pass. The visitor manipulates actual windows at their own pace.
The desktop wallpaper is a single generated still; compositing a video would add motion unrelated to reading the record.
Pixel dithering would undermine the photographic landscape and native system chrome requested by the owner.
Window dragging is direct pointer manipulation. Apple-design supplied the immediate response and reduced-motion decisions in this iteration.
Marketing effects and novelty controls would pull this desktop away from familiar Mac navigation and quiet reading.
The direction is recorded in the local ZOOM direction file. Importing another site design document would obscure the new owner override.
A poster is a fixed editorial artifact. These folders need searchable, selectable documents with source links.
Illustrated scenery would conflict with the requested realism. The wallpaper uses a generated photographic landscape instead.
The broader interaction reference was not imported; direct window movement, resize and restore were implemented against the Apple design skill.
The entry is deliberately short, with direct access to the desktop and record. No marketing-page conversion pattern was added.
The Dock is an application launcher, not a gallery. Refraction through a moving carousel would make its targets less predictable.
A synthetic loading animation would suggest a boot process that is not occurring. Only actual fetch state is represented.
The local preview uses native Mac icon artwork. Animated line icons would mix a different visual system into the Dock.
No signup, campaign or sales funnel is part of the public record. The welcome note explains how to explore the work.
Type-system changes are unrelated to this design iteration. The existing JavaScript modules remain the implementation boundary.
Writing is presented as a Notes reading view. Page curl and magnification would introduce a second document metaphor.
Liquid-metal button effects would make the Mac chrome feel ornamental. The current controls use quiet native-like materials.
A bookshelf duplicates the existing writing archive with a different browsing model. Notes keeps the desktop vocabulary coherent.
No library was imported for direct manipulation. Pointer capture tracks dragging and native CSS handles restrained hover response.
This package was not invoked in the current pass. Copy was written directly from the public record and checked in rendered entry and Notes views.
The workspace has no orders, shopping cart or fulfillment surface. Its receipts document published claims.
The owner asked for ordinary Mac navigation. Decorative backgrounds and showcase effects are not used in Finder or the Dock.
No local registry component was copied into this pass. The desktop uses bespoke DOM windows and native preview artwork.
Notes uses flat paper color and legible text, while the desktop uses a raster photograph-style asset. A procedural surface is unnecessary.
No still-to-video sequence is part of this iteration. Desktop movement comes from the visitor moving real controls.
A product marketing reference does not supply the Finder, Notes or window-management behavior this request requires.
Text effects and animated backgrounds would not improve record discovery. This pass prioritizes working folders and full-width mobile reading.
The experience does not scrub a movie. The retained camera and direct desktop route respond to navigation actions.
The Apple design skill supplied the hierarchy for system controls. No SaaS component review was applied from this package.
Historical captures were read as project history, not imported as design assets. New screenshots show the actual Mac implementation.
The physical scene is pending reference photos. This pass preserves its camera route and removes the requirement to traverse it first.
The machine snapshot is a reading of exported fields, not a distributed-systems diagram or architecture explainer.
The owner explicitly chose authentic macOS. General stylistic exploration was subordinate to that concrete visual target.
No thought indicator is warranted by saved records. An animated orb would imply live agent activity the page does not receive.
The visitor-facing workspace displays published static records rather than running arbitrary tools, so a tool canary monitor is irrelevant to reading claims and notes.
The existing spatial transition remains in place. Apple-design guided direct window motion and reduced-motion behavior for the new desktop.
Choosing a style from a general catalogue would dilute the requested native Mac direction. Mobile layout was assessed in actual 375px captures.
The work remains a local prototype. No Vercel deployment, configuration or production route was changed.
The new local direction document and implementation record carry the owner override. No external design schema was required.
No generated 3D asset was commissioned during this software pass; the physical setup awaits the owner photographs.
There are no new shots rendered to video. Desktop screenshots and interactive window behavior are the review artifacts.
The desktop does not include playback media. A single wallpaper and genuine app artwork provide the current visual assets.
Search returns matching public records without ranking a social feed. The site has no algorithmic recommendation surface.
